rules.rule: Treat this FastAPI and local-AI service as security-critical. Require Pydantic models at external boundaries, typed contracts instead of untyped dictionaries, validation of model/tool results, async correctness, resource cleanup, session isolation, and safe pathlib-based filesystem handling.

Ollama is the local inference and embedding boundary. Flag cloud model clients, external schema references, remote model endpoints, telemetry, or fallback behavior that could send confidential content off the workstation.

Tool execution, sandboxing, artifact creation, export, and save must be gated by deterministic policy and explicit user approval. Flag bypasses or model-directed authorization. Citations must be rendered from retrieval metadata, not text generated by a model.
